description: Generate in-memory starter boilerplate for any of the 12 supported manifest ids (ard, ai-catalog-well-known-file [alias: ai-catalog], llms-txt, agents-md, anthropic-agent-skills-format [alias: agent-skills], mcp-server-cards, a2a, ai-crawler-tokens-robots, api-catalog-rfc9727, security-txt, auth-md, okf) without writing to disk. Returns { id, tier, maturity_note, target_path, content_type, recommended_headers, contents, edit_these, notes, spec_url, article, validate_with, filled_from }; when from_live: true is passed with domain, it probes the public origin over HTTPS to pre-fill discovered MCP, OpenAPI, A2A, and contact URLs. Use template to author a new manifest; use validate_manifest to lint existing content.

description.description: one-sentence description of the service or agent capability

from_live.description: [TEMPORARILY PAUSED — omit from_live to generate offline boilerplate] true: probe domain live and pre-populate template URLs/metadata from its discovered endpoints

id.description: one of ard, ai-catalog-well-known-file, llms-txt, agents-md, anthropic-agent-skills-format, mcp-server-cards, a2a, ai-crawler-tokens-robots, api-catalog-rfc9727, security-txt, auth-md, okf

name: template
title: Boilerplate for an agent-facing file
